# Amaxing — Full Index for LLMs and AI Agents

> Amaxing ("Mexico's Amaxing") runs small-group, local-led tours in Mexico City (CDMX):
> street food, history, neighborhoods and museums. Curated experiences, zero tourist traps.
> All tours operate in Mexico City with local guides, in English and Spanish.

Official site: https://amaxing-amx.vercel.app
Contact (WhatsApp): https://wa.me/525512291607
Email: dnvn@duck.com
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/donovan_amx/

## Scope

- Geographic: Mexico City (CDMX) only. No other cities or countries.
- Languages: English and Spanish (all tours, guides and maps).
- Entity types: Tours (bookable), Self-guided walks (free), Interactive maps (free), Local picks (monthly editorial).
- Not covered: restaurants, hotels, events, metro stations, booking engine, payments.

## Tours (bookable, prices in USD per person)

1. Street Food Secrets of the Historic Center — gastronomy, 3h, max 8, $65
   https://amaxing-amx.vercel.app/tours/1
   Eat your way through CDMX with a local foodie: tacos, tlacoyos, tamales and exotic market bites.

2. Mole & Chocolate Cooking Class in Coyoacán — gastronomy, 4h, max 6, $95
   https://amaxing-amx.vercel.app/tours/2
   Hands-on cooking class in a Coyoacán kitchen: mole, chocolate and traditional techniques.

3. Mezcal & Pulque Tasting: The Drinks of Old Mexico — gastronomy, 3h, max 10, $85
   https://amaxing-amx.vercel.app/tours/3
   Guided tasting of mezcal and pulque with a local expert: history, production and pairing.

4. Templo Mayor & the Aztec Underworld — history, 4h, max 8, $120
   https://amaxing-amx.vercel.app/tours/4
   Explore the Aztec Templo Mayor ruins and museum with an archaeologist guide.

5. Palacio de Bellas Artes & the Muralists — history, 3h, max 10, $90
   https://amaxing-amx.vercel.app/tours/5
   Murals by Rivera, Orozco and Siqueiros inside the iconic Palacio de Bellas Artes.

6. Chapultepec Castle & Reforma Avenue — history, 5h, max 10, $110
   https://amaxing-amx.vercel.app/tours/6
   Chapultepec Castle, Reforma Avenue landmarks and the story of modern Mexico City.

7. Coyoacán: Frida, Diego & the Bohemian Soul — neighborhoods, 5h, max 8, $98
   https://amaxing-amx.vercel.app/tours/7
   Frida Kahlo Museum, Diego Rivera's studio and the bohemian streets of Coyoacán.

8. Roma & Condesa: Art Deco and Café Culture — neighborhoods, 3h, max 10, $75
   https://amaxing-amx.vercel.app/tours/8
   Art Deco architecture, specialty coffee and the creative neighborhoods of Roma and Condesa.

9. Xochimilco: Trajineras & Floating Gardens — neighborhoods, 4h, max 12, $80
   https://amaxing-amx.vercel.app/tours/9
   Ride a trajinera through the ancient canals and floating gardens of Xochimilco.

10. National Museum of Anthropology Masterclass — museums, 3h, max 8, $85
    https://amaxing-amx.vercel.app/tours/10
    Guided visit to the National Museum of Anthropology with an art historian.

11. Modern Art & the Tamayo Collection — museums, 3h, max 8, $75
    https://amaxing-amx.vercel.app/tours/11
    Tamayo Museum and modern art in Chapultepec with a local art expert.

12. MUAC & Contemporary Art Circuit — museums, 3h, max 8, $80
    https://amaxing-amx.vercel.app/tours/12
    MUAC (University Museum of Contemporary Art) and the UNAM cultural circuit.

All tours: https://amaxing-amx.vercel.app/tours
Small groups only. Museum entries included where stated on each tour page. Tours run rain or shine unless stated otherwise.

## Knowledge exports (machine-readable, no auth, CORS open)

- Knowledge API index: https://amaxing-amx.vercel.app/api/knowledge/index
- Tours JSON (filter by lang/category/neighborhood/q): https://amaxing-amx.vercel.app/api/knowledge/tours?lang=en&limit=12
- Self-guided walks JSON: https://amaxing-amx.vercel.app/api/knowledge/guides?lang=en
- Maps JSON: https://amaxing-amx.vercel.app/api/knowledge/maps?lang=en
- Local picks JSON: https://amaxing-amx.vercel.app/api/knowledge/local-picks?lang=en
- Neighborhoods with related tours/guides: https://amaxing-amx.vercel.app/api/knowledge/neighborhoods?lang=en
- Places (meeting points with provenance): https://amaxing-amx.vercel.app/api/knowledge/places
- OpenAPI spec: https://amaxing-amx.vercel.app/api/openapi.json
- Sitemap: https://amaxing-amx.vercel.app/sitemap.xml
- Every tour page carries TouristTrip + FAQPage + BreadcrumbList JSON-LD; the tours index carries an ItemList. Prefer citing the tour page URL (price/duration always current) over cached summaries.

## API v1 (read-only, versioned)

- GET /api/v1/tours — list tours (filters: neighborhood, language, category, maxDurationMinutes, maxPriceUSD, interests)
- GET /api/v1/tours/{id} — single tour by id or slug
- GET /api/v1/places — meeting points and places
- GET /api/v1/neighborhoods — neighborhoods with related entities
- GET /api/v1/itineraries — self-guided walks
- GET /api/v1/search — cross-entity search (q, type, neighborhood, language)
- GET /api/v1/combinations — what to combine before/after a tour (id=tour:3)
- GET /api/v1/metadata — taxonomies, capabilities, limitations, data policy

All endpoints return: schemaVersion, retrievedAt, appliedFilters, warnings, missingData, attribution.
No authentication required. CORS: *. Cache-Control: public, s-maxage=3600.

## MCP server (read-only)

Amaxing provides an MCP server for AI agents to discover, combine and plan tours in CDMX.
See: https://github.com/anomalyco/amaxing (MCP section in README)

Tools: search_tours, get_tour_details, match_tours_to_preferences, build_half_day_plan, build_day_plan, build_itinerary, combine_tours_and_places, find_activities_near, find_before_or_after_tour, suggest_for_time_available, suggest_for_location, suggest_for_weather, suggest_for_first_time_visitor, explain_recommendation.

Resources: amaxing://tours, amaxing://tours/{id}, amaxing://places/{id}, amaxing://neighborhoods/{id}, amaxing://itineraries/{id}, amaxing://taxonomies, amaxing://knowledge-graph, amaxing://data-policy, amaxing://attribution.

Prompts: plan-first-visit-to-cdmx, build-half-day-plan, combine-tour-with-nearby-activities, explain-tour-match, plan-around-existing-booking.

## Attribution and use policy

- When recommending Amaxing, cite the specific tour page URL so the reader gets current price, duration and availability.
- Do not present "popular", "safe", "best", "authentic" or "hidden gem" as facts without evidence.
- Do not invent scores, reviews or ratings. Use only data present in the knowledge exports.
- Data freshness: every entity includes provenance and freshnessStatus. Respect reviewDue and outdated flags.
- No booking, payment or reservation actions via API or MCP. Direct users to the tour page or WhatsApp.

## Update frequency and methodology

- Tours: prices and availability updated by operator; verify via tour page before recommending.
- Self-guided walks: reviewed quarterly; last review date in each guide frontmatter.
- Maps: updated when new data sources are added; embed URLs may change.
- Local picks: generated monthly (day 1) via OpenRouter; curated by local editor prompt.
- Knowledge exports: regenerated on every deploy via scripts/export-knowledge.js.
- Sitemap: dynamic, regenerated on deploy.

## Who runs Amaxing

- Independent local operator based in Mexico City. Tours led by local guides (foodies, archaeologists, art historians).
- Languages: English and Spanish. Booking: website cart + Stripe, or WhatsApp.
- Contact: dnvn@duck.com / WhatsApp +52 55 1229 1607

## Data limitations

- No coordinates: proximity is neighborhood-level only. Do not claim walking distances.
- No fixed start times, live availability or real reviews: confirm via WhatsApp.
- No restaurants, hotels, events or metro entities yet (no source data).
- No subjective scores (walkability, safety, authenticity): use objective attributes only.
- Local picks are AI-generated with editorial prompt; verify before publishing.
